# Superpowers DSH reference package

Language: English.

Registers the `superpowers-reference` reference Skill. It grants no tools and includes no upstream code, documentation, data, examples, or assets. See the project’s `.docs/en/guide/setup.md` and `UPSTREAM.json`.

## Automatic selection

Automatic selection is off by default for each Agent. Use `/dsh-superpowers-tonulls on` and `/dsh-superpowers-tonulls off`; direct Skill invocation remains available.
